caption: The drawing depicts a circular, perforated object with two handles at the top and a small support or tab at the bottom. The surface of the main circular body is covered with regularly spaced holes arranged in a radiating pattern. The object appears metallic, as indicated by the shading and reflective highlights rendered in shades of gray. Below the main drawing, there is a small inset plan showing a side profile of the object with dimensions marked. The drawing is enclosed within a rectangular border, and in the lower right corner, the name "Aaron Fosterovsky" is handwritten in cursive. The overall composition is done in pencil or graphite on off-white or light beige paper.
title: Silver Punch Strainer
